cases.rationale: Two actual cats are visible: a black cat behind the upright luggage lid and a tabby occupying the open luggage. The large zippered shell, opened lid and lined luggage compartment identify a suitcase. Its lining and loose clothing do not identify a backpack, bed or other furniture; the scraps of material and packaging do not identify any food, utensil, book or other listed object. I considered each of the 75 definitions over the entire crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The grazing striped equids, including the one cut off at the left edge, are actual zebras, with distinctive body striping and zebra build; they do not satisfy horse. The rest is grass, trees, distant buildings and enclosure rails. Rails do not identify a bench, and the trees have no visible plant pots. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no other listed object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual pedestrians and the red pedal bicycle with spoked wheels, frame, saddle and pedals are clear. A recognizable passenger car is visible in the shop-window view/reflection at left. The gray head with yellow top and parking-payment face identifies a parking meter, rather than a traffic light. The dark bag on the nearer pedestrian is partly occluded: backpack (24) versus carried shoulder handbag (26) cannot be resolved from its visible body and straps. The clipped white tubular object at the extreme left could be a chair (56), but too little seat/back structure is visible for a firm identification. I considered all 75 exact definitions, including these competing identities; remaining categories have no identifiable object.

The central fixture is an actual toilet with raised lid/seat and visible bowl. The curved white basin and plumbing at the left identify a sink, not a portable bowl. At upper left, green leaves emerge from a visible pale plant pot. The right-hand large fixture is a bathtub, outside the listed categories, and the stone sink counter is not a dining table. The mirror and window are not TV displays. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real black-and-white waterbird is perched in the foreground, with feathered body, webbed feet and a long bill, supporting bird rather than a kite, toy or statue. The perch is weathered concrete or rock without identifiable bench structure; the background is water and a blurred shore. I considered every one of the 75 definitions, and no other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is present.

The stacked rigid travel cases have luggage handles, reinforced corners and closures, identifying suitcases. The tan soft carried bag near the lower center has a short carrying handle and handbag form, distinct from the rigid cases and a backpack. Two small stuffed bear toys sit on the cases: their plush bodies and teddy faces identify teddy bears, not actual bear animals. The decorative pictures on a rear case do not count as actual depicted objects. I considered all 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The rainbow segmented canopy at the lower storefront is an identifiable actual umbrella. Small humanlike forms near the doorway and shop display are too small and obscured to distinguish a real person from mannequins/display figures, so person (0) remains unclear. The upper windows and shop signage do not identify televisions, and indistinct merchandise, hanging clothes and small round display objects do not establish bags, books, clocks or other listed categories. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; the unresolved ambiguity is the human versus display-figure identity.

A woman crouches and extends her hand toward the dark face of a large woolly sheep; other sheep and portions of standing people are visible behind. The fleece and sheep heads support sheep rather than dogs, cattle or goats. The rest of the crop contains grass and clothing, without an identifiable listed bag, accessory, food, furnishing or device. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A child and the child's hands are visible using an open white laptop. Its integrated screen and base identify laptop, and its visible physical keys also satisfy keyboard. The integrated display is excluded from TV, and the large touchpad is not a separate mouse. The supporting surface is a work desk, not an eating table; on-screen text is not a physical book. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A tall straight drinking glass of beer is a cup/tumbler under the frozen definition, without the stem and foot required for wine glass. The foreground plate holds thin pizza crust with toppings and recognizable remaining pizza portions. A tined fork and broad table-knife blade are visible; overlapping reflective cutlery at the clipped left edge could additionally include a spoon (44), but its bowl/handle structure cannot be resolved. The plates and drinking vessel establish an eating-table context; the flat plates are not bowls. Red toppings do not identify apples or oranges, and other vegetable pieces do not specifically identify carrot or broccoli. All 75 definitions were considered; spoon is the remaining category ambiguity.

An actual elephant with thick legs, broad body and trunk stands on the open bed of a blue road truck. A person's arm/body appears at the cab, and a small white passenger car is identifiable behind the truck at the right. The partly hidden large blue vehicle at the far left has a windshield/front that could belong to a bus (5), but the crop does not resolve bus versus another truck, so bus stays unclear while the foreground truck is definite. Building signs are advertising rather than stop signs or signals. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; no other listed object is identifiable.

The foreground animal has a very long neck, long legs and characteristic large brown polygonal patches, identifying an actual giraffe even though its upper head is cropped. Its markings and anatomy do not identify zebra, horse or cattle. Rocks, dry earth and unpotted vegetation fill the surroundings; no additional listed object is identifiable. All 75 exact definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.
